seo.title: Links — OpenMixer
seo.description: The OpenMixer source repository, the sibling FreeREAC interoperability project, and the upstream projects OpenMixer is built on.

hero.title: Where the code is, and what it stands on.

openmixer.what: The whole console: the model, the server, the surface, the native PipeWire engine and its C signal processing, the plugin catalog, the adapters and the documentation set. A pnpm workspace, GPL-3.0-or-later.
openmixer.noLink: The repository is not open to the public at the moment, so there is no link here. When that changes this card gets one.

links.freereac: The sibling project: open documentation and tools for Roland's REAC, the audio-over-Ethernet protocol the stageboxes speak. OpenMixer holds the control path for a stagebox; FreeREAC is where the protocol work lives.

upstream.title: What OpenMixer is built on.
upstream.text: None of these are ours. They are the projects the console would not exist without, and the ones to read if you want to understand the layer underneath it.
upstream.pipewire: The audio graph the console lives in. OpenMixer's engine is a native PipeWire client and its signal processing is a filter node in that graph.
upstream.lv2: The plugin standard the insert chains use. Anything that ships an LV2 can be racked into a strip or an output.
upstream.modHost: The LV2 host the insert chains are built on, from MOD Devices.
